title: Lilienthalstraße, Hallbergmoos
description:
🏄‍♂️ Top Location: Right next to the new O2 SURFTOWN MUC & perfectly connected to the airport!
🛋️ Fully equipped, modern studio (16–20 m2) featuring a stylish walk-in shower
🛏️ Comfortable bed, dedicated workspace & flat-screen TV for your comfort
🧺 Access to vibrant community spaces, laundry area (WeWash) & pet-friendly on request
🚗 On-site parking, only 4 km to the airport & 30 min to Munich city center via S8

🛋️ The Apartment
Enjoy a sleek and thoughtfully furnished single apartment with approx. 16–20 m2 of space. The room includes a 90x200 cm bed, a flat-screen TV, a desk and dining table with chair, and plenty of closet space.

The kitchenette features a grill microwave, fridge with freezer compartment, kettle, dishes, cutlery, and glassware—everything needed for daily living.

The modern bathroom includes a walk-in shower, soap and shower gel dispensers, a hairdryer, fluffy towels, and a make-up mirror.
Please note: These are sample images. The interior design may differ visually, e.g., due to a different carpet, furniture placement, and colors.

🏢 Building & Services
The building offers a range of convenient services and amenities, including:
- Weekly cleaning service with linen & towel change
- High-speed WiFi available throughout
- WeWash laundry facilities, bookable via app
- Inviting community spaces
- Parking on-site and along the street
- Pets welcome upon request


📍 Location
Situated in Hallbergmoos, just 4 km from Munich Airport and only 30 minutes to Munich city center via S8.
Shops, public transport, and green spaces are easily accessible.
- Dining Options: Within minutes, you’ll find Il Girasole (Italian), Eisvogel (international), El Greco (Greek), and India King (Indian cuisine).
- Fitness & Wellness: Access to gyms and fitness facilities nearby, including those at hotels within the SKYGATE complex.
- Walking distance to SURFTOWN ARENA.

Perfect for business travelers, airport commuters, or anyone looking for a peaceful stay with quick access to the city.
